subtests.name: Simple test for getCoalescedEvents() of `pointerrawupdate`
getCoalescedEvents() of pointerrawupdate should return one event
type should be "pointerrawupdate"
isTrusted should be true
bubbles should be false
cancelable should be false
target should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
screenX should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
screenY should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
clientX should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
clientY should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
button should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
buttons should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
pointerId should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
pointerType should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
shiftKey should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
ctrlKey should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
altKey should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
metaKey should be same as the pointerrawupdate event
target should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
screenX should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
screenY should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
clientX should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
clientY should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
button should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
buttons should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
pointerId should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
pointerType should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
shiftKey should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
ctrlKey should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
altKey should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
metaKey should be same as the corresponding pointermove event
